properties.description: Built 2026-10-21 (phase 7 PR 2, epoch:planned-p7-a-hub-on-one-machine), for a hub reached only through the --call door. An opt-in parameter on search_design. On a design that pins others (external_dependency with a graph_id) and is not served from a registry, each pinned design's committed export is read into a fresh in-memory design that serves read-only and reaches no server, and the same query runs there with the same full-text engine. The reply is the hub view's merged shape (service/view.rs merged_search_payload): one ranked list bounded by the one `limit`, each hit naming its `design`, a pinned design's node_id prefixed '<graph_id>:<id>', with designs_searched, found_by_design, searched_by_design, hits_withheld, read_from and design_names. Every pinned design NOT searched is in `not_searched` (PR 1's shape, cap:a-search-names-the-pinned-designs-it-did-not-search) with a `state` — missing, unreadable (not a design, or an export of another design than the pin names), not_reached (pinned at an address), nowhere, not_read (past upstream's read cap of 16), not_followed (pinned only by a pinned design) — and why. A read aimed at a pinned design (`member`, or an id with its prefix) runs on that export alone, so a hit opens with get_node; a write aimed at one is refused. Nothing is written to any export, no git runs, nothing is fetched. Without the argument the reply is unchanged. On a registry the handler says the argument was not served; through a hub's address the view already searches every member and says so (tracked_note). Scores come from each design's own index, so the order across designs is a guide. DEFERRED: a design pinned at an address is named not_reached, never asked (cap:a-tracked-search-reaches-a-design-at-its-address, planned). MCP: service/tracked.rs, service.rs call_tool, tools/query.rs, service/view.rs. Realizes req:one-search-reaches-every-design-a-hub-tracks (exports); ruled by dec:until-designs-share-a-server-the-cross-design-check-runs-at-the-hub.
properties.name: search_design with `tracked_designs: true` runs the same query in every design this one pins whose committed export reads on this machine, and names each pinned design it could not search and why
